preconditions: Independent Primary4/rubric/accessibility review; medical/local response knowledge separately reviewed before classroom use.
Artwork is a neutral teacher-assigned source study, no political preference, affiliation, advocacy or real campaign. Preserve source-asset attribution and rights.
Phone simulation uses paper or a completely disconnected device checked by the teacher; never make a live test call, create smoke or stage an injury.
No first-aid procedure on a pupil, clinical diagnosis, hot water, real ice application, public disclosure or actual complaint/contact.
evidenceRequirements: Record actual individual artwork or simulated words/actions against the relevant criteria; a plan alone is not performance.
Check readable source-image rendering before artwork delivery; no image decoding/redrawing occurred during source acquisition.
